blocks.orig: The luxurious andBeyond – Grumeti Serengeti River Lodge is located in the remote western foothills of the Serengeti National Park. There are few other lodges here and you rarely see other vehicles. This ensures an extraordinary experience with the feeling of ultimate exclusivity. Rustic yet refined, this camp has a warmth that makes you feel at home and part of the family. All ten tented suites have shaded private verandas overlooking the riverfront. Large day beds make this the perfect place to spend the afternoon. The interiors combine wildebeest grey tones with accents of natural stone and bone. Stone shower towers are open to the sun and stars. Intimate guest areas include seating and dining areas with open fronts and a vaulted bar, where you indulge in lovely sundowners and delicious food.
blocks.html: In the remote western foothills of Serengeti National Park you find the luxurious andBeyond – Grumeti Serengeti River Lodge. Only a few other lodges are nearby and other vehicles are a rare sight. The result is a remarkable stay that feels truly exclusive. Rustic but refined, the camp has a warm atmosphere that makes you feel at home and like one of the family. Each of the ten tented suites has a shaded private veranda looking out over the river. With their large day beds, they are ideal for spending the afternoon. Inside, wildebeest grey tones are paired with touches of natural stone and bone. The stone shower towers are open to the sun and the stars. The intimate shared spaces include open-fronted lounge and dining areas and a vaulted bar, where you can enjoy lovely sundowners and tasty food.
